рушати.text: Inherited from Old East Slavic рꙋшати (rušati), from Proto-Slavic *rušati. By surface analysis, рух (rux) + -яти (-jaty).

sources.quote: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *ęti (“to take”), reanalyzed after the verbs prefixed with *vъn-, *sъn- (vъn-ęti → vъ-nęti, sъn-ęti → sъ-nęti). The "й" at the front arose by analogy with йма́ти (jmáty), іма́ти (imáty).

йняти.text: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *ęti (“to take”), reanalyzed after the verbs prefixed with *vъn-, *sъn- (vъn-ęti → vъ-nęti, sъn-ęti → sъ-nęti). The "й" at the front arose by analogy with йма́ти (jmáty), іма́ти (imáty).
